message: The recommended way to deploy is now via the Vercel CLI. Follow the steps below to deploy your project.

steps.title: Check if the Vercel CLI is installed
steps.note: If this fails or the command is not found, proceed to step 2. Otherwise skip to step 3.

steps.title: Check if you are logged in
steps.note: If this prints your username, skip to step 5. If it errors, you need to log in.

steps.title: Log in to Vercel
steps.note: This opens a browser to authenticate. If you are in a non-interactive environment (CI, SSH, agent sandbox), use a token instead: vercel --token <YOUR_VERCEL_TOKEN>. Create a token at https://vercel.com/account/tokens

steps.title: Deploy your project
steps.note: Run this from your project directory. The --yes flag skips confirmation prompts. On first run it will auto-create and link a Vercel project. This creates a preview deployment.

steps.title: Deploy to production (optional)
steps.note: Use this instead of step 5 if you want a production deployment.

tips: Set environment variables: vercel env add <NAME>
alternative: You can also deploy through the Vercel dashboard at https://vercel.com/new by importing a Git repository.
